newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index drops 2.23 pct in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index drops 2.23 pct in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down 2.23 percent in higher trade on retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN sharp drop, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 588.47 from 601.65 on Thursday. Volume was 4.8 million dinars against 1.70 million dinars.
Monoprix, one of three firms traded through the computerised system introduced last month, was down 10.46 dinars to 33.78 dinars.
"Since the Monoprix share was traded on the computerised system, there has been more transparency over its true value," a broker commented.
"Small investors who bought Monoprix shares last year are selling because they feel the market was adjusting its price in a downward trend," he said.
BIAT bank eased 1.85 dinars to 59.95 dinars with 50,917 shares changing hands. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 1.14 dinars to 39.17 dinars.
